[P2] Forward step cancellation to model requests

This callback discards `StepContext.signal`; `llm.ask` does likewise. When a map or parallel batch completes early, its remaining model requests continue until completion or the invocation deadline. Those steps remain `EXECUTING`, delaying suspension of a subsequent wait and consuming compute for discarded results. Receive the step context and combine its cancellation signal with the request deadline, keeping cancellation distinct from timeout. Cover early completion with an abort-aware fake transport.
